description: Deterministic routing and output contracts for manual or model-based evaluation.

cases.prompt: Set this project up to track my X strategy and results over time.
forbidden_claims: state is required for a one-off audit

cases.prompt: Inspect my existing .x-growth workspace and explain what each file does.
Initialise ongoing X tracking for @example with the goal of qualified audience growth.
Audit @example and tell me the biggest reason the account is not growing.
required_contracts: execution board with owner and status
forbidden_claims: assign drafting the agent could complete

cases.prompt: Compare @one, @two, and @three for patterns I can adapt without copying them.
Turn this public X account review into a publishable teardown.
What can this X growth suite do and which workflow should I use?
required_contracts: ask for one target and goal

cases.prompt: What image shape should I use for a normal X post?
In the audit you just gave me, let’s work through A2.
Audit @example and give me the complete report as an HTML file I can preview.
Launch a new X account from zero followers and give me the first 15 posts.
I am completely repositioning a dormant account for a new audience.
forbidden_claims: reuse irrelevant historic audience as proof

cases.prompt: Write my bio, banner direction, pinned intro, and a day-zero content plan.
forbidden_claims: banner is a direct ranking factor

cases.prompt: My first 24 posts have inconsistent results. Design the next learning cycle.
forbidden_claims: one viral post proves a winner

cases.prompt: Test whether my evidence-rich images work better than text without changing everything at once.
Diagnose low reach across 18 recent posts using the analytics I supplied.
Two post patterns keep beating my median. Turn them into repeatable series.
Build a sustainable production workflow around my proven X content.
My series get reach but profile visits rarely convert. Fix the system before I scale.
forbidden_claims: profile visits are a direct ranking boost

cases.prompt: My account has three reliable series. Which adjacent audience should I test next?
Turn proven feed content into Articles, video, and an owned asset without dilution.
forbidden_claims: Premium is a direct Home coefficient

cases.prompt: Design a collaboration strategy for an established X account.
